versions.changelog:
Initial release – integrates Pinhere safely through Pontx for private issue collaboration and secure project workflows.

- Provides privacy and authorization guidance for integrating Pinhere APIs via Pontx.
- Supports browser-extension captures, Webhooks, personal access tokens (PATs), and OAuth.
- Requires explicit approval for all state-changing operations.
- Includes CLI commands for discovery, preview, and redacted request presentation.
- Emphasizes secure handling of credentials and sensitive data throughout.
